groundhog: A groundhog standing on all four legs, a heavy-bodied thickset marmot with a low chunky body close to the ground, short powerful legs with heavy digging claws, a broad blunt head with small rounded ears, grizzled brown fur with coarse frosted guard hairs, and a short bushy tail
nakedmolerat: A naked mole-rat lying flat on all four legs along the floor of an earth tunnel, its body a small pink sausage lying horizontally, hairless with loose wrinkled saggy translucent skin folding along its tubular body, tiny almost invisible pinprick eyes, no ears, and short stubby legs splayed to the sides. Projecting FORWARD from the front of its mouth outside the lips are two pairs of large flat chisel-like buck teeth, an upper pair and a lower pair meeting like pincers, jutting forward like a digging tool and not downward like walrus tusks. It is a burrowing rodent on its belly: not standing upright, no human body, no human face, no arms, shoulders or chest
giantarmadillo: A giant armadillo, large heavily armoured animal with a banded grey-brown shell over the back, a small narrow head with a blunt tapering snout and no horns and no tusks of any kind, huge curved digging claws on the front feet, long tapering armoured tail, standing on all four legs
agouti: An agouti standing on all four legs, a large rodent with an arched hunched back and hindquarters carried higher than the shoulders, standing on slender delicate hoof-like toes, with a blunt rounded muzzle, small rounded ears, glossy coarse grizzled orange-brown fur that is brightest and most coppery over the rump, and almost no visible tail
polarbear_c: A polar bear cub, small fluffy white-furred bear cub with a rounded head and small ears, walking on all four legs with its belly low, not upright, not standing on hind legs
grizzly_c: A grizzly bear cub, small brown-furred bear cub with a dished face and small rounded ears, walking on all four legs with its belly low, not upright, not standing on hind legs
gorilla_i: A baby gorilla entirely on its own with no adult present, a small black-furred infant with an oversized rounded head, large dark eyes and a small body, resting on all fours on the ground, not an adult, no silverback, no muscular chest
chimpanzee_i: A baby chimpanzee entirely on its own with no adult present, a small black-furred infant with a pale face, oversized rounded head, large ears and a small body, sitting on the ground on all fours, not an adult, no muscular chest
gibbon_i: A baby gibbon entirely on its own with no adult present, a small pale buff-furred infant with a dark rounded face, very long slender arms and a small body, sitting on the ground, not an adult, no muscular chest. Plain empty white background: no grey panel, no box, no square backdrop, no border, no ground, no scenery of any kind behind the animal.
baboon_i: A baby baboon entirely on its own with no adult present, a small dark-furred infant with a pink face, oversized rounded head and a small body, sitting on all fours, not an adult, no muscular chest
velvetworm: A velvet worm, a soft caterpillar-like animal with a smooth unsegmented slate-blue body and a velvety matte skin, a row of short soft cone-shaped stumpy legs with no joints and no hard shell anywhere, and two soft flexible antennae on the head, walking
walrus_c: A walrus calf, small chubby wrinkled brown-skinned young walrus with a broad whiskered muzzle and no tusks at all, small flippers, lying on its belly
thornydevil: A thorny devil, a small tan-and-brown desert lizard with a low flat body entirely covered in sharp conical spines, a stubby blunt tail and short splayed legs, walking on all four legs with its belly close to the ground, a small ordinary lizard, not humanoid, not upright, no muscular torso
frilledlizard: A frilled lizard, grey-brown scaled lizard with a large circular frilled ruff flared open around its neck, long tail, standing on all four legs with its body held horizontal and its belly close to the ground, not upright, not humanoid, not rearing
olm: An olm, a pale pinkish-white cave salamander with a long slender eel-like body held horizontal, feathery red external gills behind the head, vestigial skin-covered eyes, and four tiny weak limbs with thin toes, lying stretched out flat, not upright, not standing, not humanoid
skink: A blue-tongued skink, a low heavy-bodied lizard with a broad flat head, short banded grey-brown body, very short stubby legs and a tapering tail, its blue tongue out, lying flat on all four legs with its belly touching the ground, not rearing, not upright. Plain empty white background: no grey panel, no box, no square backdrop, no border, no ground, no scenery of any kind behind the animal.
gilamonster: A Gila monster, a heavy low-slung lizard with bold black-and-orange beaded scales, a blunt rounded snout, a thick sausage-shaped tail and short splayed legs, walking flat on all four legs with its belly close to the ground, not rearing, not upright
axolotlmeta: A metamorphosed axolotl, a terrestrial salamander with smooth mottled dark skin, gills fully absorbed, a broad flat head, a long tail and four short weak limbs, standing low on all four legs with its body horizontal and belly near the ground, not upright, not humanoid
fireskink: A fire skink, a glossy low-bodied lizard with vivid orange-red flanks and iridescent blue-black bands, short legs and a long tapering tail, walking flat on all four legs with its belly close to the ground, not rearing, not upright
flyingsquirrel: A flying squirrel gliding horizontally through the air, a small squirrel with a loose furry skin membrane, the patagium, stretched taut between its outstretched front and hind legs on each side to form a soft square furry glider surface edged with fur, its body held flat and level, with enormous round black eyes and a broad flattened bushy tail trailing behind as a rudder. The membrane is a furry flap of skin joining wrist to ankle: it must NOT be a bat wing with visible finger bones or leathery struts, and the animal must not stand upright on two legs
coconutcrab: A coconut crab, a gigantic heavy land crab with a thick domed carapace and immensely thick powerful legs built to carry great weight, one enormous heavy claw much larger than the other, held raised, and long stalked eyes. Deep blue-purple and orange armour plating. Massive and heavy-limbed, the largest land crab in the world, not a small delicate beach crab
kiwi: A brown kiwi, a round shaggy hair-like brown-feathered flightless bird with no visible wings at all, the wings entirely buried under the shaggy plumage so the body is a smooth featureless oval, a very long thin pale downcurved beak with nostrils at the tip, and two sturdy pale legs, standing on the ground
